verdict.rationale: Resend documents building email templates with React via React Email and sending them through the API, and it references a Templates feature. Community users confirm authoring templates in React. None of the evidence describes merge-field syntax, conditionals, loops, or any preview or test-render step. missing for 10: documented merge fields/variables, conditional and loop constructs, template preview or test-render before sending, independent hands-on corroboration of personalization.

support.subject: As a developer, I can personalize emails with a documented templating language — merge fields, conditionals, loops — and preview or test-render a template before sending
